description: Estimate a land pattern from package numbers: a generic IPC-7351-style pad width, pad length and courtyard for a perimeter package (QFN/DFN/SON leadless, or QFP/SOIC/SSOP/TSSOP/SOP gull-wing). This is a nominal estimate, NOT IPC-7351B's tolerance-stacked tables, NOT IPC-certified and NOT the datasheet's recommended land pattern: use the datasheet's own drawing when it prints one. It gives one pad size for every pad, no pad positions, no numbered pad map and no exposed (thermal) pad, so it cannot build a footprint on its own; for an official KiCad footprint use datasheetvend_match_kicad_footprint. Each value's origin is in inputs_used (given, derived from a standard outline, estimated from pitch, or formula), and caveats travel with every result. An unsupported family or a missing input is refused and named. Free, no API key, no model call, reads no account data.

density_level.description: Margin level: most (largest pads), nominal (default) or least. Nominal margins, not IPC levels A/B/C.

package_type.description: Package name as the datasheet prints it, for example 'QFN', 'LQFP', 'TSSOP', 'SOIC'.

pad_length_mm.description: A pad length to use as given instead of the formula, in millimetres

pad_width_mm.description: A pad width to use as given instead of the 60%-of-pitch estimate, in millimetres

pin_count.description: Number of terminals. Only checked to be above 0.

span_x_mm.description: Lead-tip span across the width (gull-wing only; give both spans or neither), in millimetres

span_y_mm.description: Lead-tip span across the length (gull-wing only; give both spans or neither), in millimetres

name: datasheetvend_calculate_land_pattern
title: Estimate a land pattern (IPC-7351-style, generic)
